name: FlipCard
description: 3D card that flips on a tuned spring around the Y or X axis to reveal a back face, triggered by hover or click and always by Enter/Space.
a11yNotes: Root is a focusable role="button" with aria-pressed reflecting the flipped state; Enter and Space flip it. The hidden face is aria-hidden so only the visible side is read. Hover-trigger cards also flip on touch tap, and prefers-reduced-motion swaps the spring for an instant flip.

defaultProps.frontText: Hover, click or press Enter to turn me over.
defaultProps.backText: Perspective, backface culling and a tuned spring. Press Enter again to flip back.

propsApi.name: frontTitle
propsApi.description: Front heading used when front is not provided.

propsApi.name: frontText
propsApi.default: 'Hover, click or press Enter to turn me over.'
propsApi.description: Front text used when front is not provided.

propsApi.name: backTitle
propsApi.description: Back heading used when back is not provided.

propsApi.name: backText
propsApi.default: 'Perspective, backface culling and a tuned spring. Press Enter again to flip back.'
propsApi.description: Back text used when back is not provided.

propsApi.name: trigger
propsApi.description: Pointer interaction that flips the card (Enter/Space always flips).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the root.
